resources.string: 4K and HDR in the corner picture
Shows the picture of 4K and HDR channels in the guide\'s corner. Turn off if the guide stutters or the TV switches to HDR while browsing; the corner then shows the channel logo with sound.
Raises the level of AAC surround channels (5.1) mixed down for stereo, which often play much quieter than other channels.
Left for channels, Right for controls, hold OK for options
